title: Zeteo Joins the Gaza Flotilla as It Sets Sail to Break Israel’s Blockade
author: Alex Colston
content:
_**A note from our Editor-in-Chief:** _

_I 'm happy to share that **Zeteo** is aboard the Global Sumud Flotilla, which
just set sail from Spain with the aim of reaching Gaza. Freelance journalist
Alex Colston will be filing dispatches, like his first one below, videos, and
updates from the sea for **Zeteo** , as dozens of boats and what's expected to
be more than 1,000 participants attempt to break Israel's blockade of the
Strip. This work is incredibly important, but it's not easy. Your support
helps us be able to commit to projects like these. _

_If you 're not already a **[paid Zeteo
subscriber](http://zeteo.com/subscribe)** , be sure to [become one
today](http://zeteo.com/subscribe) to ensure you get all of Alex's updates -

if you already are one, you can always support our work - and projects like

I'm writing from the waters off the coast of Barcelona, not long after setting
sail today aboard the Iqrit, a 50-foot schooner named after a Palestinian
village in upper Galilee near Lebanon that was depopulated during the 1948
Nakba. I am sailing with the [Global Sumud
Flotilla](https://globalsumudflotilla.org/) (GSF), a maritime direct action
organization committed to breaking Israel's siege and blockade by sea and by
land, alongside hundreds of international activists, humanitarian workers,
doctors and clinicians, teachers, journalists, and members of Greenpeace and
Open Arms. With thousands of participants from across the world, comprising
over 50 national delegations, GSF has been preparing for eight months to sail
this spring.

The goal is technically a relatively simple
[one](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/4/12/history-of-flotilla-campaigns-
to-end-israels-siege-of-gaza): sail some boats - carrying food, medical
supplies, baby formula, and other aid - from any available port in the
Mediterranean to the shores of Gaza in Palestine. But
[since](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2025/9/10/map-israel-has-attacked-
intercepted-all-gaza-bound-flotillas-since-2010) 2010, these attempts have
been anything but
[easy](https://www.democracynow.org/2025/10/3/gaza_flotilla_italy_protests).
